flags.why: The river sense is characteristic of Central Vietnamese, as documented in the [Huế dialect dictionary](https://khungcuahep.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/T%E1%BB%AB-%C4%90i%E1%BB%83n-Ph%C6%B0%C6%A1ng-Ng%E1%BB%AF-Hu%E1%BA%BF-Tr%E1%BA%A7n-Ng%E1%BB%8Dc-B%E1%BA%A3o.pdf), so Northern is misleading.
Thơ ca means poetry, not the arts generally; the [dictionary definition](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-th%C6%A1%20ca) does not support this separate sense.
